CustomField.description: Text formula written on read from TotalGiftsAmount (optionally combined with TotalSoftCreditsAmount) against the FQS_Donor_Grouping__mdt lifetime thresholds.
CustomField.formula: IF((TotalGiftsAmount + FQS_Legacy_Total_Gifts_Amount__c + IF(TEXT($CustomMetadata.FQS_Donor_Tier__mdt.Major.Credit_Type__c) = "Hard + Soft Credits", TotalSoftCreditsAmount + FQS_Legacy_Soft_Credit_Total__c, 0)) >= $CustomMetadata.FQS_Donor_Tier__mdt.Major.Lifetime_Min_Amount__c, $CustomMetadata.FQS_Donor_Tier__mdt.Major.Branded_Name__c, IF((TotalGiftsAmount + FQS_Legacy_Total_Gifts_Amount__c + IF(TEXT($CustomMetadata.FQS_Donor_Tier__mdt.Mid.Credit_Type__c) = "Hard + Soft Credits", TotalSoftCreditsAmount + FQS_Legacy_Soft_Credit_Total__c, 0)) >= $CustomMetadata.FQS_Donor_Tier__mdt.Mid.Lifetime_Min_Amount__c, $CustomMetadata.FQS_Donor_Tier__mdt.Mid.Branded_Name__c, IF((TotalGiftsAmount + FQS_Legacy_Total_Gifts_Amount__c + IF(TEXT($CustomMetadata.FQS_Donor_Tier__mdt.Entry.Credit_Type__c) = "Hard + Soft Credits", TotalSoftCreditsAmount + FQS_Legacy_Soft_Credit_Total__c, 0)) >= $CustomMetadata.FQS_Donor_Tier__mdt.Entry.Lifetime_Min_Amount__c, $CustomMetadata.FQS_Donor_Tier__mdt.Entry.Branded_Name__c, "")))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set automatically. The branded lifetime donor grouping name for this donor based on total giving to date. Your administrator controls both the thresholds and the branded names.
CustomField.label: Lifetime Donor Tier Name
